_doc: VR world markers: replace the original's in-world HUD (target brackets, health bars, numbers, progress bars) and add what VR needs without the 2D panels. Units metres and seconds; colours linear RGB, drawn emissive and partly transparent, depth-tested but never hidden completely (draw a faint copy without depth test so markers show through walls). Billboard parts face the eye. Sizes are for street scale (1:1); scale with the world in table-top mode but keep a minimum angular size.

selection.label: M1
selection.replaces: the selected agent shown in the 2D agent panels
selection.shape: ground ring under each player agent (radius 0.45 m, 4 cm wide) with four tick arcs, rotating 90 degrees per 2 s; agent number 1-4 on a billboard plate 2.2 m up with corner brackets

hover.label: M2
hover.replaces: target brackets on the thing under the mouse (draw_hud_target_mouse)
hover.shape: four corner brackets around the person (0.9 x 2.0 m) or vehicle (its bounds), billboard, gentle 6% breathing
hover.colour_rule: neutral for people, hostile for enemies in range, friend for own agents
hover.game: the thing the controller ray points at (VR pointer)

lock.label: M3
lock.replaces: shrinking target frame of targeting weapons (draw_hud_target2: size 4 * (18 - WeaponTimer))
lock.shape: brackets start at 2x and shrink to 1x while the weapon aims (acquiring colour), then turn hostile red with a flash and a small diamond in the centre
lock.time: follows WeaponTimer: size = max(1, (18 - WeaponTimer) / 9) of the base frame

health.label: M4
health.replaces: vehicle health bars (draw_vehicle_health); also for people in VR
health.shape: billboard bar 0.6 x 0.07 m, 2.25 m above people (above the bounds for vehicles), dark back, 5 segments; on damage the fill drops at once and a white trail follows after 0.25 s over 0.75 s
health.show: own agents always; others for 3 s after being hit or while hovered

charge.label: M5
charge.replaces: long progress bars (draw_sort_sprite_long_prop_bar), e.g. weapon charge
charge.shape: ring of 32 segments at waist height around the agent (radius 0.55 m) filling clockwise; flashes when full
charge.game: weapon charge state (TngF_WepCharging and its timer; needs swcore additions)

persuaded.label: M6
persuaded.replaces: nothing in the original (its persuaded people just follow)
persuaded.shape: spinning diamond 2.2 m above each persuaded person, ground ring, and a dashed tether to the persuader whose dashes flow towards them
persuaded.game: persuaded flag and owner (needs swcore additions)

waypoint.label: M7
waypoint.replaces: nothing visible in the original (move orders are clicks)
waypoint.shape: destination: a dot with three rings pulsing outwards; path: chevrons on the ground lighting up in sequence towards the destination; disappears on arrival
waypoint.game: the GOTO command the player gave (front end side) or the person's goto position

damage.label: M8
damage.replaces: floating numbers and short texts (draw_sort_sprite_number / short_text)
damage.shape: billboard text rising 0.8 m over 1.8 s and fading; red for damage to enemies, white for others; also used for short tags (e.g. PERSUADED, NO AMMO)

objective.label: M9
objective.replaces: the objective text and map marker in the 2D panels
objective.shape: light column 6 m high fading upwards, spinning diamond on top, ground ring; visible through buildings
objective.game: SwcWorldInfo.objective (text) and the objective's thing / place
